facts.fact: Smart Africa's profile of Guinea states that Guinea joined the Smart Africa Alliance in 2016.

Smart Africa's profile states that Guinea, through its regulator ARPT, chairs the Smart Africa Council of African Regulators; it gives no date for the appointment, so the document's publication date of 2025-09-09 is used.
